advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.description: Fine-tune PowerClimate behavior. Leave fields empty to use defaults. Changes take effect immediately.

data_description.min_setpoint_override: Absolute minimum temperature sent to any pump (default: 16°C).
data_description.max_setpoint_override: Absolute maximum temperature sent to any pump (default: 30°C).
data_description.maximum_overshoot: Maximum permitted overshoot above the target temperature.

data_description.assist_timer_seconds: Duration a condition must remain true before action is taken (default: 300 seconds).
data_description.assist_on_eta_threshold_minutes: Turn assist pumps on if the ETA exceeds this value (default: 60 minutes).
data_description.assist_off_eta_threshold_minutes: Turn assist pumps off if the ETA drops below this value (default: 15 minutes).
data_description.assist_min_on_minutes: Keep assist pumps on for at least this long (default: 20 minutes).
data_description.assist_min_off_minutes: Keep assist pumps off for at least this long (default: 10 minutes).
data_description.assist_water_temp_threshold: Turn assist pumps on when water reaches this temperature (default: 40°C).
data_description.assist_stall_temp_delta: Temperature difference threshold for stall detection (default: 0.5°C).

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Experimental features. These settings may change without notice.

data_description.supply_advice_sensor_entity_id: Optional sensor with an advised supply temperature, from any source: a heating curve template, an MPC integration or other. Enables the Supply advice preset; PowerClimate steers the water heat pump's setpoint so the measured supply temperature follows the advice.
data_description.supply_pi_kp: Setpoint change in °C per °C difference between advised and measured supply temperature (default: 0.15).
data_description.supply_pi_ti_minutes: Time in which the integral adds one proportional step; longer is slower and calmer (default: 45 minutes).
data_description.supply_pi_min_power_w: Below this water heat pump power the compressor counts as idle and the integral stops (default: 200 W).
